name: NIH Documents: Biosketch, Current and Pending, MFTRP
intro_text:
Once a year, the Center collects everyone’s Current and Pending (Other) Support for its progress report to NIH (RPPR). If you’re named on the Notice of Award, NIH also needs your biosketch and an MFTRP certification.
Make the biosketch and the Current and Pending in SciENcv, using NIH’s Common Forms, and upload the certified PDFs here.

about: Each year the Center reviews the Current and Pending (Other) Support of its project leaders, core directors and PD/PI.
People named on the Notice of Award also give a biosketch and MFTRP certification for the RPPR.

mftrp.label: Download your certification form (PDF, your name already filled in)
How to sign it with an Adobe digital signature (step-by-step guide, PDF)

questions.prompt: Will there be, in the next budget period, either (1) a reduction of 25% or more in the level of effort from what was approved by the agency for the PD/PI(s) or other senior/key personnel designated in the Notice of Award, or (2) a reduction in the level of effort below the minimum amount of effort required by the Notice of Award?
questions.help_text: This is RPPR question D.2.a, word for word. In short: will your CNAP effort drop by 25% or more next budget year (starting June 1)? NIH treats a Yes as a request for prior approval. If the drop has already happened, tell the evaluator, because a separate request is needed.

questions.prompt: If Yes: describe the change, with your current and planned calendar months and when the change starts.
Named on the Notice of Award (set by the site)

sections.title: Current and Pending (Other) Support
sections.instructions:
Make it in SciENcv (www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sciencv), using NIH’s Common Form.
Certify it yourself in SciENcv, then download the PDF. Don’t flatten it afterward: NIH checks the certification. Your ORCID iD must show in the Persistent Identifier (PID) section.

questions.prompt: Current and Pending (Other) Support: Common Form (certified PDF from SciENcv)

sections.title: Biosketch
sections.instructions: You’re named on the Notice of Award, so NIH also needs your biosketch: the Common Form with the NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement, in one PDF from SciENcv. Certify it there the same way, and don’t flatten it.

questions.prompt: Biosketch: Common Form with the NIH Supplement (certified PDF from SciENcv)

sections.title: MFTRP certification
sections.instructions:
Every year, NIH requires each senior/key person to certify in the RPPR whether they are a party to a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP).

Four steps:
- Download your form below.
- Sign it with an Adobe digital signature; the guide below walks you through it.
- Flatten it, as NIH asks: print it to PDF (Microsoft Print to PDF on Windows, or Save as PDF on a Mac).
- Upload the flattened PDF here.

sections.title: Foreign-activity documents (only if you have any)

questions.prompt: Supporting documentation: copies of contracts for foreign appointments, or for employment with a foreign institution (optional, one flattened PDF)
questions.help_text: NIH takes these as a separate attachment, not inside your Current and Pending. Leave this blank if you have none.

_source: MW 2026-10-27: PPLs, RPLs, core directors and the CNAP Director upload SciENcv biosketch and Current and Pending once a year; MFTRP certification and D.2.a in the same task; optional foreign-activity documents. Piestar thread (Apr 2026) for D.2 and MFTRP. SciENcv Common Forms required for RPPRs from Jan 25, 2026 (Stanford ORA notice). Wording per NOT-OD-26-018 (Common Forms; NIH Biosketch Supplement; don't flatten SciENcv PDFs; annual MFTRP certification in RPPR G.1 as a flattened PDF named MFTRPcert_[Name].pdf; supporting documentation as a separate flattened attachment) and NOT-OD-26-033 (enforced from May 8, 2026). MW 2026-10-27: Current and Pending from everyone on the list; biosketch and MFTRP only from people named on the Notice of Award (Person.senior_key, default PD/PI and RP Leaders), via a hidden site-set question.
